name: vision_imagenet_ddp
title: ImageNet-style classifier: DDP + AMP + gradient accumulation + EMA + one-cycle warmup, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: the shape torchvision's own classification reference and timm's train.py have - a config dataclass, a data module, a model module, an engine module with train_one_epoch/evaluate, and a torchrun entrypoint

forbidden.why: the training loader passes a DistributedSampler (which shuffles) and shuffle=(train_sampler is None), which is exactly the documented MLV110 sampler guard
both evaluation loaders are built with shuffle=False
every loader is built inside build_loaders(), which is only reached from the run() guarded by if __name__ == '__main__' in main.py
eval_transform() is Resize + CenterCrop + ToTensor + Normalize; every random operator lives in train_transform()
zero_grad(set_to_none=True) runs before the loop and again at every accumulation boundary - the documented gradient-accumulation guard
scaler.step(optimizer) is called at every accumulation boundary
the order is scaler.scale(loss).backward() then unscale_ then clip then scaler.step()
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region; the only no_grad here decorates evaluate() and ModelEma.update()
running_loss accumulates loss.item(), a Python float
OneCycleLR is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() is called once per optimiser step inside the batch loop
the AMP protocol is complete: scaler.scale(loss).backward(), scaler.unscale_(optimizer) before the clip, scaler.step(optimizer), scaler.update()
clip_grad_norm_ sits between unscale_ and scaler.step(), which is the only correct position
evaluate() calls model.eval() as its first statement and restores model.train() at the end
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
accuracy_topk ranks with logits.topk(...).indices before comparing to the targets, so the metric never sees raw scores
ResNetish.forward returns self.head(self.dropout(x)) - raw logits - and the criterion is CrossEntropyLoss
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss anywhere in this project
move_batch() puts both the images and the targets on the model's device before every forward
pick_device() returns a CUDA device only after torch.cuda.is_available() says so
set_seed() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda, and run() calls it first
there is no random split in this project - the three splits are three ImageFolder directories
BasicBlock, ResNetish and ModelEma all call super().__init__() on the first line of __init__
the per-stage block lists are wrapped in nn.Sequential(*blocks) and collected in an nn.ModuleList
save_checkpoint writes state_dict()s and load_checkpoint passes map_location= and weights_only=True

gaps.what: the scaler and the scheduler are parameters of train_one_epoch, so scaler.scale(loss).backward(), scaler.step(optimizer), scaler.update() and scheduler.step() produce no graph node at all and MLV201/202/203/207/208/209 cannot see the training step
gaps.evidence: the six graph ops at engine.py:69,70,72,77,78,80 are labelled and not recovered in either dataflow mode
